description: Completed 52 m² apartment project in Bratislava by DUMSKAYA DESIGN: interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. Technical documentation, detailed estimate, photorealistic 3D visualizations and photos of the completed interior and custom-made furniture.
h1: Apartment Interior Design in Bratislava, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 52 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design in Bratislava, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 52 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a comprehensive project for a 52 m² apartment in Bratislava, including interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture design and manufacturing, and turnkey renovation.

The project covers the main functional areas of the apartment: living room, bedroom, kitchen with individually planned storage and built-in appliances, dressing areas, entrance hall and bathroom. Custom wardrobes, shelving and integrated storage systems were also incorporated into the interior.

Custom-made furniture was designed and manufactured for each area, taking into account the dimensions of the rooms, layout and functional requirements. Developing the interior and furniture as one integrated concept made it possible to use the available floor area efficiently while maintaining a consistent visual character throughout the apartment.

Before renovation began, a detailed project estimate was prepared covering renovation works, construction and finishing materials, custom furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment and lighting. The project was implemented as a comprehensive process — from the development of the interior concept and technical documentation to renovation, furniture manufacturing and installation.

The page features photorealistic 3D visualizations, photographs of the completed interior and custom-made furniture, providing a clear comparison between the developed design concept and the final result.
